name: AI Engineer
summary: Backend Engineer with 6+ years of production experience in Python and Node.js, including hands-on work integrating OpenAI's API into a deployed, scalable backend system. Built and shipped an asynchronous AI-powered document processing pipeline with confidence-based workflow routing, deployed on AWS Lambda and processing 1,000+ documents weekly with 98% accuracy. Strong foundation in API design, async processing, background jobs, and both SQL and NoSQL databases, with growing experience in agent frameworks and retrieval-based AI systems.
